title: Global unsafe VFIO mode never substitutes for per-device DMA provider proof
blocker: The repository now has a Qman component that rejects noiommu and performs a real cdev/IOMMUFD bind and IOAS attach, but it is not integrated with an authoritative G1 snapshot publisher, durable lease, the current Legacy authorized-path launcher/receipt, a separately qualified future cdev launch grant, post-start verification, or physical E4 qualification.
assertions: host global unsafe mode does not by itself make the target ineligible
a target backed by /dev/vfio/noiommu-N is rejected
an IOMMU-backed Legacy group or separately qualified cdev is independently proven at attach time
